images.name: lightning_branch_01
images.prompt: Generate one centered hand-drawn lightning branch junction: short left stub, two thin jagged unequal rightward forks with needle tips; four flat grayscale planes, dark tapered contour, light-gray majority and white core under 25%. Transparent RGBA background. Requested canvas 512×512 and painted extent 120×100 pixels. Match reference 2's value-plane language and reference 1's painted register. No glow, gradients, texture, scenery, shadow or text. Retry emphasized reducing the oversized body to 120×100 native pixels even if the tool retained a 1254×1254 canvas.

retries.reason: First candidate's painted extent exceeded the requested size by more than 25%.
retries.change: Emphasized a 120×100 native-pixel body with larger empty margins and uniform value planes.

concerns: Delivered unchanged at 1254×1254, not the required 512×512.
Painted extent remains oversized, visually approximately 360×260 pixels.
Alpha channel is present; genuine alpha-zero background, opaque interior and fringe width were not numerically verified.
